_comment: OpenAI-compatible text API settings template. The client sends packet text and saves the reply; it has no local file, terminal, or tool loop.

fields.label: Base URL
fields.help: OpenAI-compatible API root. /v1 is appended when missing.

fields.label: API Key
fields.help: Keep the key in the task project's ignored .cache/laohu-luna/diy.json or set LAOHU_LUNA_API_KEY. Never commit it.

fields.label: Model
fields.help: The provider's model identifier used only when the user explicitly selects diy-openai.

cli.api_key: set LAOHU_LUNA_API_KEY in the environment or use the local settings flow; do not put the literal key in command history
